Mo & Krill.why: Still the default sustained front line, and the 11-04 buffs give it teeth again: Scorn heal 1.3x, Combo 50 HP/kill and a wider Burrow make his grind-down lockdown convert, while the Healbane 4-stack cap cut protects that sustain from coordinated anti-heal.
Mo & Krill.notes:
Minor Update 11-04: Scorn heal 1.2x->1.3x, Combo HP/kill 40->50, Burrow radius +0.5m, Sand Blast T2 slow -24%->-28%; Healbane 4-stack cap 82.2%->72% protects Scorn sustain.
Halloween 2026: spirit per boon 1.1->0.6 and -10% spirit damage on every ability; Combo untouched, bullet per boon +4% — move one slot to gun (Bullet Lifesteal/Battle Vest). Torment Pulse +4% melee resist up; Decay's deeper self-heal penalty and Healbane heal-on-kill 275->170 down.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder Haunt camps and contested Buff Containers reward his sustained frontline; objective parries no longer reset, trimming the free Guardian-dive chain.

Ivy.why: Still the best peel in the game (Stone Form i-frame/stun) and a 53.7% WR support; the Healbane 4-stack cap cut (82.2%->72%) gives tether healing room back, but the gun core is still the only build worth funding after the Halloween heal-item trims.
Ivy.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Healbane 4-stack cap 82.2%->72% eases the anti-heal tax on tether healing; gun core remains the funded path.
Halloween 2026 (indirect, item-driven): Healbane now stacks across sources — the worst system change for tether healing — Healing Booster lost its Extra Regen upgrade and +3 flat regen, and Healing Nova moved to spirit scaling off her gun-first build. Skip the heal package.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Healing Snacks plus spread corridors cut the value of a grouped healer; districts pull her team apart, so tether a frontline bruiser sweeping corridors instead of a lane partner.

Yamato.why: Still the camp-clear and objective-path champion, but Flying Slash 26->23m and Shadow Transformation at T2/160s cut her engage reach; the Healbane 4-stack cap cut trims the team value of her anti-sustain slot, and Mo & Krill's Scorn buff makes her worst tank matchup harder.
Yamato.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Healbane 4-stack cap 82.2%->72% trims the team value of her anti-sustain slot; Mo & Krill Scorn 1.2x->1.3x sharpens her 42% matchup.
Halloween 2026: Flying Slash 26->23m (T3 +15->+8m) with the mark visible on cast, Shadow Transformation 150->160s and moved to T2, Power Slash +6% spirit scaling. Hunter's Aura LOS gate and Healbane kill-heal 275->170 trim her late spirit line; Torment Pulse +4% melee resist helps her commit.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20): Flying Strike creates paths against solid targets (turrets, Shrines, objectives) for extra mobility/objective access; parry no longer resets on objectives, so her Shrine/Walker dive is one-shot.

Shiv.why: The knife exchange is still good (Serrated Knives 4% current HP) and the Healbane 4-stack cap cut eases the anti-heal tax on his regen shell, but Radiant Regeneration is still in-combat-only at 40, so he starts fights smaller than before Halloween.
Shiv.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Healbane 4-stack cap 82.2%->72% eases the anti-heal tax on his regen shell; Yamato and Drifter, his worst matchups, untouched.
Halloween 2026: Serrated Knives rage 3.5%->4% + T3 spirit scaling up, Killing Blow recast 16->12s, alt-fire per boon -5%; Radiant Regeneration went in-combat-only at 65->40 and Healbane kill-heal 275->170, so his pre-fight buffer is gone — Torment Pulse +4% melee resist is the offset.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): harder camps reward his regen stack and the rising frontline feeds current-HP Serrated Knives, but vents hand divers a free approach before he ramps.

Grey Talon.why: Sub-50% poke carry with no camp or crate route; Lash (36%) is his worst lane and took no nerf, so the patch is pure drift against a 47.4% baseline.
Grey Talon.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): no changes; Lash keeps Grapple T3 and remains his worst lane at 36%, and no camp/crate/objective lever moved for a hero with no farm route.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Steam Vents give roamers a free approach on an immobile flyer, and Healing Snacks blunt the poke he turns into lane leads; no camp or crate route suits him.
Paint the Town (10-16, indirect): flyer tax unchanged (air-drag slows, Silver's Weighted Bola) and rising Lash (36% for Grey Talon) is his worst lane — stays C.

Lash.why: Highest-pick S-tier initiator: spirit stomp core untouched, Grapple T3 +4m jump velocity, and Steam Vents refill stamina at +150% — the dive-and-re-enter loop got more fuel. Paige's base bullet 35->32 removes pressure from one of his few losing lanes.
Lash.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Paige base bullet 35->32 (~9% lane cut) softens one of his five losing matchups; spirit stomp core and Grapple T3 untouched.
Halloween 2026: Grapple T3 adds +4m jump velocity; Steam Vents converted from an invisibility approach to +150% stamina regen, which feeds his dash-and-re-enter pattern rather than the set-up gankers who used to ride vents. Spirit stomp core untouched.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): districts and Steam Vents extend his dive routes beyond three lanes, and hub fights at Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza concentrate teams into Ground Strike; objective parries no longer reset.

Viscous.why: Splatter T1 +45 damage and +5% alt-fire growth give his lane poke real numbers, but Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.3x and Combo 50 HP/kill sharpen his worst matchup (43%), and the Healbane cap cut helps the sustain frontlines that already out-trade his Cube shell.
Viscous.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Mo & Krill Scorn 1.2x->1.3x and Combo 40->50 sharpen his 43% matchup; Healbane 4-stack cap cut helps sustain frontlines that out-trade Cube.
Halloween 2026: Splatter T1 +36->+45 damage and +5% alt-fire damage growth per boon, Goo Ball melee/Ethereal Shift exploit during cast delay fixed; Express Shot secondary-fire -5% sits in his core. Tier holds B.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): Bell Tower's spread vaults and four corridors suit Goo Ball traversal, and harder camps plus forced hub fights raise Cube rescue value.

Pocket.why: The economy still funds his slow Affliction ramp, and Celeste's Dazzling Trick silence (+1.25s->+0.75s) and Shining Wonder nerfs soften his worst matchup at 39%; he still folds to anything that out-ranges or sticks to a low-HP caster.
Pocket.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Celeste silence +1.25s->+0.75s and Shining Wonder nerfs soften his 39% worst matchup; Healbane cap cut helps sustain heroes that outlast Affliction, which cuts both ways.
Halloween 2026 (indirect): the comeback levers (non-hero comeback cap 26->30%, tick souls to the two poorest, deficit-scaled secure speed) reverse the premise of his B-falling read — the farm bail-out now arrives before his Affliction spike. No core item moved.
Changelog: 09-16 - no direct line; 30-day usage shows no gun build (Monster Rounds 92%, Cultist Sacrifice 93%), so the spirit stack stands.

Mirage.why: Split-push hybrid the patch buried: souls moved off the lanes into corridors and shared objectives, so sidelane pressure converts to less income, and Mo & Krill's Scorn 1.3x/Combo 50 HP deepens his 40% matchup; farm corridors instead.
Mirage.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Mo & Krill Scorn 1.2x->1.3x and Combo 40->50 deepen his 40% matchup; Healbane single-source value unchanged, so his core slot gains nothing.
Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit. (10-20, indirect): souls moved off the lanes into corridors and shared objectives, so split-push converts to less income; Steam Vents give roamers a free approach on his map-play.
Paint the Town: no direct change; contested Soul Bags and earlier hub objectives worsen a slow split-pusher, and rising M&K/Lash dive him off his map-play — beaten by the meta, not the notes.

Drifter.why: Blind-pickable spirit-melee bruiser whose roaming income is still rich, but the Healbane 4-stack cap cut (82.2%->72%) trims the anti-heal bruiser composition that paired it with his built-in heal cut; the spirit melee core is untouched.
Drifter.notes:
Minor Update 11-04 (indirect): Healbane 4-stack cap 82.2%->72% trims the payoff of his anti-heal bruiser build; spirit melee core untouched.
Halloween 2026: base gun damage +3%, Bloodscent T3 +11%->+12% amp, Eternal Night T3 +2.5->2.75s; Haunt bounty/growth +10% raises his crate/vent roam income and multi-source anti-heal now composes with his built-in heal cut.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Steam Vents, new hiding spots and heavy-melee Tough Crates extend his stealth-roam and give his melee core uncontestable crate income.
